The search for the MTD starts at the dose below the one at which #> escalation stopped, or at the highest dose when it is escalated from. #> No MTD is selected when the search moves below the starting dose.

code: # Scenarios 16 and 17 of Lu et al. (2025) scenarios <- list(   "Scenario 16" = list(     p_true = matrix(c(0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.15, 0.20, 0.45), nrow = 2),     p_resp = matrix(c(0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.60), nrow = 2)),   "Scenario 17" = list(     p_true = matrix(c(0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.40, 0.50), nrow = 2),     p_resp = matrix(c(0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.55), nrow = 2)) ) oc <- sim_comb_boin12_multi(   target = 0.33, target_resp = 0.2, scenarios = scenarios,   n_cohort = 14, cohort_size = 3, n_trials = 100,   psi00 = 100 * 0.11 / 1.11, psi11 = 100 / 1.11, benchmark_weight = 0.6,   extrasafe = TRUE, offset = 0.10, seed = 1 ) oc #> Comb-BOIN12 operating characteristics across 2 scenarios #>   DLT limit            : 0.33 #>   response limit       : 0.2 #>   dose levels          : 2 of drug A, 3 of drug B #>   trials each          : 100 #>   max sample size      : 42 #>   ties / no candidate  : higher / nearest #>   OBD selection        : logistic response, rectangle bound #>  #>     Scenario True OBD OBD selected (%) Patients at OBD (%) No OBD (%) #>  Scenario 16     A1B3               40                31.3          2 #>  Scenario 17     A2B2               28                20.9          1 #>  Above limit selected (%) Patients above limit (%) Patients DLTs Responses #>                        16                     22.8     41.2  9.4      17.8 #>                        40                     38.0     41.6 11.0      15.7
